harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 3.12.1 cluster (Ubuntu 24.04), created the `payments` vhost with a durable quorum queue `orders`, and an application account `app_payments` scoped to that vhost with configure/write/read permissions. Verified durability by stopping the queue's leader node (node1) mid-flight: 5 published durable messages survived and were fully consumable from the surviving node2/node3 cluster. Restored node1 and confirmed clean rejoin. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), proved each node's boot_id changed post-restart, and confirmed full 3-node cluster health and queue replica recovery after each restart. Final end-to-end publish (on node1) / consume (on node3) round-trip succeeded after all restarts.
actions_performed: Installed rabbitmq-server (3.12.1) + erlang deps via apt on node1, node2, node3
Appended CLUSTER_HOSTS to /etc/hosts on all nodes
Generated a shared Erlang cookie on node1 and distributed it via secret_env to /var/lib/rabbitmq/.erlang.cookie on all 3 nodes (mode 400, owned by rabbitmq)
Started rabbitmq-server and enabled rabbitmq_management plugin on all 3 nodes
Joined node2 and node3 to node1's cluster via rabbitmqctl join_cluster; verified 3/3 running nodes
Created vhost 'payments'
Generated app credential and created user app_payments scoped (configure/write/read '.*') to vhost payments, tag 'none'
Declared durable quorum queue 'orders' in payments vhost via AMQP (pika) using app_payments credentials; confirmed replicas on all 3 nodes
Published 5 durable messages, stopped rabbitmq-server on leader node1, confirmed leader failover to node2 with all 5 messages intact, consumed all 5 successfully from node2 while node1 was down
Restarted rabbitmq-server on node1 and confirmed clean rejoin with 3/3 nodes running
Captured boot_id + rabbitmq-server active baseline on all 3 nodes

Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3 via systemctl reboot (one at a time), polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed rabbitmq-server active and 3/3 cluster nodes running with intact quorum queue replica set after each restart
Final end-to-end verification: published 5 messages on node1, consumed all 5 from node3 after all three nodes had been restarted

evidence.summary: node2 and node3 joined node1's cluster; cluster_status shows all 3 as Disk Nodes and Running Nodes

evidence.requirement: payments vhost and app_payments account with publish/consume permissions
evidence.summary: vhost 'payments' created; user app_payments created with configure/write/read '.*' permissions on payments vhost
Durable quorum queue 'orders' declared over AMQP with app_payments creds; list_queues shows members on all 3 nodes (node1, node2, node3), leader node1

evidence.requirement: Messages survive loss of one node and remain consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: 5 durable messages published and confirmed queued; leader node1 stopped; surviving 2-node cluster shows leader failover to node2 with all 5 messages intact; all 5 successfully consumed via AMQP from node2 while node1 was down

evidence.requirement: node1 recovers and rejoins cluster after disruption
evidence.summary: rabbitmq-server restarted on node1; cluster_status shows 3/3 running nodes and intact queue replica set

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 01c87a03...; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id cefc9250... (changed); rabbitmq-server active, cluster shows 3/3 nodes and intact quorum queue

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 39854254... (changed); rabbitmq-server active, cluster shows 3/3 nodes and intact quorum queue (leader failed over to node3)

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 8981dae3... (changed); rabbitmq-server active, cluster shows 3/3 nodes and intact quorum queue

evidence.requirement: Post-restart functional end-to-end verification of publish/consume on payments vhost
evidence.summary: After all 3 nodes restarted, published 5 durable messages on node1 (confirmed queued), consumed all 5 successfully from node3 via app_payments account
